title: Albertina Sisulu's birth chart
metaDescription: Albertina Sisulu's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 27.2° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Moon stands at 18.7° Taurus, in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 27.2° Libra, inside the third decan (20°–30°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Mercury. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Mercury holds 1.2° Scorpio, Venus holds 18.7° Libra, Mars holds 14.4° Sagittarius — in the old shorthand, thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that begins as conversation; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts the Sun a sixth of the circle apart from Saturn, 1.1° off exact. Sextiles are read as standing invitations — productive exactly as often as they are accepted. Behind it, Saturn opposition Uranus at 2.2°, and Venus square Jupiter at 3.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags five placements in this chart. The Sun in Libra at 27.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; the Moon in Taurus at 18.7° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Libra at 18.7° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Cancer at 15.5° is in exaltation; Saturn in Leo at 26.1° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 3, water 3, fire 3, earth 1; modalities fixed 5, cardinal 4, mutable 1. An air-weighted chart thinks in through-lines; the sentence is how it takes hold of the world. Uranus and Pluto were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Taurus for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 15.0° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 18.7°.
